description: The workbook contains annual streamflow and sediment loads from 1956 to 2024 at six Yellow River stations: Tangnaihai, Lanzhou, Toudaoguai, Tongguan, Huayuankou and Lijin. This resource is provided by Shihua Yin. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists XLSX formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The title also names storage capacity and NDVI, but the description does not document their resolution or completeness. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
